intervention_annotation.numeric_control: Compatible with the independently decoded published numerical contract under the explicitly declared current runtime profile; physical status remains UNKNOWN
intervention_annotation.offset_intervention: Shift the selected mean or both quantile bounds in a separately recorded deployment artifact
intervention_annotation.slope_intervention: Increase selected std, or expand quantile bounds symmetrically about their center, in the deployment artifact
intervention_annotation.fixed_offset_slope_composition: Predeclared composition of the above; not an independently sampled root cause
intervention_annotation.selection: First finite nondegenerate action coordinate selected from metadata before execution. Freeze absolute changes large enough to exceed the declared reference tolerance using metadata alone. Never tune on observed outcomes.
intervention_annotation.evidence_erasure: Derived reference ablations; preserve original capture identities, label reduced authority/units and never fit replacements from outputs

dependency_and_split_rules: Exact prospective metadata revisions have not been executed; metadata inspection is disclosed and is not blinding.
ACT move-cube and SmolVLA move-cube, their descendants and all existing outcomes remain development.
Shared SmolVLA base ancestry is linked across development and prospective metadata. No ancestry-disjoint generalization claim follows.
All PI05 LeRobot/OpenPI transport cells remain one artifact cluster; LIBERO shared corpus links to retrospective OpenPI remain explicit.
Previously developed fault recipes remain known recipes. Exclude them from unseen-root-cause claims and independent held-out-incident denominators.
Queries, random seeds, injected variants, transported copies and repeated environments are repeated measurements, not new independent research samples.
Frozen manifests and analysis must precede prospective outcomes. Any later change requires an amended protocol and an honest rerun label.

planned_query_designs.budget: 2n+1 normalization queries for each of eight designs per condition; one native normalization call per query, not an invented temporal schedule
planned_query_designs.scope: Separate shared-oracle geometry comparisons from end-to-end comparator results

comparison_requirements: Compiled, independent pointwise and strongest relational oracle receive identical observations/reference authority and numerical profiles.
Static metadata comparison and genuine paired native round trips use the actual intended/deployment artifacts, including deliberate mutations.

The prior normalization certificate retains its exact paper profile or an explicitly labeled, native-checked framework coordinate extension; thresholds are descriptive unless frozen as a decision rule.
Original stateful checker applies to its matched SO101 domain; preserve native full report and explicit projection.
Native robotruth uses stock extraction/checking and preserves severity/refusal vocabulary; missing weights or physical fields are not detections/false alarms.
Other external workflows require an explicit supported evidence contract. Unsupported response/rollout/kinematic domains are N/A limitations, not wins.
Provenance/authority/state/witness ablations retain original scope labels; reduced checks do not certify erased requirements.

analysis_plan.primary_reporting: Full condition tables, finite numerical and full checkpoint/physical statuses kept distinct
analysis_plan.clusters: Three published artifact rows with explicit shared code/base/corpus dependencies; PI transport is nested in PI
analysis_plan.uncertainty: Descriptive per-artifact paired differences and leave-one-artifact-out sensitivity; no population confidence intervals, mutation-level significance tests or family-generalization claims
analysis_plan.witness: Genuine fresh replay of the same original failed relation; count native calls/actions/events, not only query labels; report unavailable witnesses and negative size findings
analysis_plan.cost: Separate cold import/setup, native query work, evaluator work and measured peak RSS; document actual configuration/LOC and setup commands without inventing human-study times

budget.dependency_downloads: Separate pinned environment setup; not benchmark metadata

eligibility_decisions: Exclude original GCS PI statistics from prospective vendored artifacts while their generation-specific licensing remains unresolved.
Use the pinned publisher-Apache-declared PI05 small metadata reserve only for its declared numerical scope. Upstream weights are neither downloaded nor relicensed.
Record OpenPI transport as a counterfactual runtime experiment, not original checkpoint reproduction or another independent policy.
Panda software-controller authority comes from actual pinned native package/operators and offline lifecycle execution, independently of any PI metadata mapping.
remaining_freeze_gates: Implement action-only native published-metadata execution without forging the existing temporal query format.
Finish matched-evidence baseline/ablation adapters and certificate profile handling.
Validate runner/reporting/witness logic on development metadata and self-authored fixtures only.
Freeze exact per-case inputs, numerical profiles, condition artifacts, seeds, budgets, method applicability and all execution/analysis source hashes in a committed protocol.
Run prospective cells only after verifying that committed freeze; retain failures and deviations.
